Olga: Heads-up — just wrapped a 45m onboarding with Horizon Health. They like perf but surfaced three repeat blockers for go‑live: team-level routing flags, a privacy/PII marker to stop logging/caching of sensitive prompts, and clearer per-account onboarding checklist visibility in the console. Captured raw asks below — need product prioritization + timelines. @Anya @Devon

Anya: Thanks — can you paste the raw asks so I can drop them into the PRD?

Olga: Sure, pasted from my notes:
```
- Team feature flags: allow teams/orgs to set routing policies (e.g., route prod traffic to higher-SLA model, staging to cheaper model)
- PII marker: API param/header to mark a request as sensitive -> do not persist logs, skip KV-cache/embedding store, and route through private-only path
- Onboarding checklist: shareable checklist in Console with per-account status + owner so CSMs can track enablement progress
```

Marcos: FYI — this is a renewal conversation. Horizon said explicitly they "can't go live" until the privacy marker exists. Ballpark impact = ~$80k ACV renewal. PII ask is a blocker.

Devon: Noted. @Sam can we estimate effort? Short-term/long-term split would help sales/CS.

Sam: Tech quick take: PII header is feasible as a fast follow. Implementation sketch:
1) Honor header X-Redwood-Privacy: pii (or similar)
2) At runtime, skip persistence paths (no embeddings uploads, no long-term request logs), bypass prefix cache writes, and mark request as non-attributable in metrics
3) Add audit flagging so customers can request logs if needed via legal process
Estimated: ~2w for core work + 1w tests/docs, assuming no infra surprises. Trade-off: reduces token-level analytics fidelity.

Anya: Could we ship an "opt-out logging" API flag first (server-side only) and follow with Console controls? ProductOps/CS can coordinate messaging.

ProductOps: I can own rollout plan and customer comms. Recommend gating the console toggle behind Enterprise tier and exposing the header for early access. Will draft KB and a one-pager for CSMs. :memo:

Olga: Great. Marcos — want me to mark this in the renewal tracker as 'blocking'?

Marcos: Yes please — mark Horizon Health as blocking and attach these notes to the account record in SF. I'll flag for the AE.

Anya: I'll open a GH issue and label as customer-reported + renewal-blocker. Devon set priority?

Devon: P0 = PII marker (renewal blocker). P1 = team-level routing flags. P2 = onboard checklist visibility.

Sam: I'll start an RFC in eng-platform and include the fast-path header option and the longer-term product changes.

ZenBot: Created issue redwood/infra#2345 from @Anya — https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/2345 :white_check_mark:

Olga: Thanks everyone — I'll paste the meeting recording + transcript into the SF note and link to the GH issue. Can we reconvene in 48h for a quick sync on acceptance criteria? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
